property_summary: After any number of calls to play(), the total pot in the contract must remain zero if no payout has ever occurred or if the last call did not trigger a payout; the mutant incorrectly clears the pot when a payout does not occur, leaving pot non-zero even when random != 0.
change_summary: Change the condition from random == 0 to random != 0, inverting when the payout occurs.
